title: Fellow devs — help an indie dev out with a wishlist? Just launched my Steam page
author: Thin_Medicine3833
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev!                                                                                                                                                                                                    

Been working on integrating LLMs into a real-time 3D companion for a while now and finally got the Steam page up. You know how it is early wishlists make or break visibility on Steam.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 

If you've got 2 seconds, a wishlist would genuinely help:

🔗 [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4216640/AIKO\_AI\_Girlfriend\_3D\_Life\_Sim/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4216640/AIKO_AI_Girlfriend_3D_Life_Sim/)



For those curious about the AI side:

  \- Real-time LLM conversations (Hermes-3-Llama-3.1-70B via DeepInfra) — no dialogue trees

  \- Persistent semantic memory — she remembers things across sessions

  \- Emotional state machine that influences how the AI responds

  \- Custom prompt architecture to keep personality consistent over thousands of conversations

  \- Biggest headache was stopping personality drift over long conversations

Happy to talk shop about any of these systems if you're working on something similar. And if you've got a Steam page too, drop it below happy to wishlist back.🙏
